title: Stansted airport's APM 100 re-texture
description: A re-texture of the APM-100 to Stansted airport from Ultimate-USA-YT.
body: This is a re-texture of the APM-100   https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cx100-tampa?version=1.20.1   With the look of Stansted airport's shuttle. Maybe in the future will be custom audio sounds like in real life.
